tasks.q_en: The door crashes to the floor, and a giant walks into the hut. It's Hagrid, and he's brought Harry a cake. You came here with him in the boat because you're getting your letter too. Harry is about to learn the truth about himself.

tasks.q: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle) = experience or result with no finished time: I've just broken the door. Have you ever seen a giant? You've kept it from him for eleven years. items.q: At exactly midnight the door fell with a crash. A real ____ walked into the hut.
“Sorry about the door,” he said, and put it back in place.
Then he took a slightly squashed ____ out of his pocket.
He lit a fire with a pink ____, and nobody understood how.
Then he said the words that changed everything: “Harry, you're a ____.”
“I'm a what?” whispered Harry. He had never heard anything stranger.
At last he read his letter: he had been ____ at Hogwarts.
Hagrid was furious: “You've ____ this from him for eleven years?!”
Hagrid explained that a wizard had gone to the ____ side and killed them.
He wanted to kill Harry too, but the ____ didn't work.
Harry ____, and became the most famous child in the wizarding world.
I was sitting in the corner, afraid even to breathe.
That night I understood: our lives would never be ordinary again.
